subject: Avoid useless seek in xtrim (#2985)
reason: The change adds an early return in streamTrim when trim_strategy is MAXLEN and s->length <= maxlen, purely to skip allocating and seeking a rax iterator. The identical condition was already the first check inside the trim loop (t_stream.c:726), so the old code broke out of the loop on the first iteration with deleted=0 and no mutation; the new code returns 0 before the loop. Return value, stream state, replies, keyspace notifications and replication/AOF propagation are byte-identical on both builds for every input (maxlen 0, empty stream, approx trim, LIMIT, XADD and XTRIM paths).
